pf.title: Pool Fence Hire in Bali — Removable Child-Safety Fence for Villas
pf.h1: Pool fence hire for your Bali villa
pf.lead: Most Bali villa pools have no fence. We install a removable child-safety fence around your pool before you arrive — and take it away when you leave.
why: Many Bali villas have a pool right outside the bedroom doors — often with no barrier.
Toddlers are fast, and drowning is quiet: it doesn't look like the splashing in films.
A fence gives you a safety layer for the moments you look away — unpacking, cooking, answering the door.
steps: A short video or a few photos on WhatsApp is enough to measure.
We agree installation with the villa manager if needed.
Fixed around the full pool edge with a self-latching gate.
pf.note: A fence is an extra layer of protection, not a replacement for supervision. Always watch children near water.
faq: Will it damage the villa?
The fence is designed to be removed without leaving marks. Tell us about the pool deck surface and we'll confirm the fitting method.
Does the villa need to agree?
Usually villa managers welcome it; we can coordinate with them directly.
Can we still use the pool?
Yes — adults open the gate; it closes and latches by itself.
How far in advance should I book?
As early as possible in peak season (July–August, Christmas). Installation can be done before you arrive.

ARTICLE.title: Things to Do in Sanur with Kids (2026 Family Guide)
ARTICLE.h1: Things to Do in Sanur with Kids: The Complete Family Guide
ARTICLE.desc: Beaches, playgrounds, water activities and a 3-day plan for families in Sanur, Bali — from a local nanny agency.
ARTICLE.byline: By [Author], reviewed by [Nanny coordinator] · Updated September 2026
ARTICLE.lead: Sanur is the calmest, most walkable corner of Bali for families: reef-protected water, a flat beachfront path and short distances. Here's how to spend your days there with kids of any age.
ARTICLE.mid_p: A nanny can come to your hotel or villa tonight.
secs: Sanur's reef keeps the water calm, which makes it one of the easiest places in Bali for small children to swim. Sindhu, Semawang and Mertasari beaches are the family favourites. Swim around high tide; at low tide the water drops far out over the reef.
Several beachfront cafes along the Sanur path have playgrounds, and there are indoor soft-play options for the hottest hours of the day.
Stand-up paddleboarding, snorkelling trips and swimming lessons all work well in Sanur's calm water. Kitesurfing and windsurfing lessons suit older kids in the windy season.
Craft and cooking classes, indoor play centres and malls in nearby Denpasar keep kids busy when the rain comes.
The Sindhu night market, sunset along the beach path — or a dinner for two while a nanny puts the kids to bed.
Day 1: beach morning, pool and nap, sunset walk. Day 2: snorkelling or SUP, then a craft class. Day 3: a day trip to Bali Zoo or a waterpark, with an evening off for parents.

sanur.name: Sanur
sanur.lead: Calm, reef-protected water and a flat beachfront path make Sanur the easiest part of Bali for babies and toddlers.
txt: Why families choose Sanur
The reef keeps waves small, so little ones can paddle safely around high tide. The 5 km beach path is stroller-friendly, and most hotels, cafes and playgrounds are within walking distance.
What our nannies do here
Morning beach time and sandcastles, pool sessions at your hotel, naps while you take a SUP or snorkel trip, and evenings in so you can try a sunset dinner.
Good to know
At low tide the water drops far out over the reef — plan swims around high tide. Fast boats to Nusa Lembongan and Nusa Penida leave from Sanur beach.

canggu.name: Canggu
canggu.lead: Surf, cafes and villas with private pools — Canggu suits families who want an active, social Bali stay.
txt: Families in Canggu
Most families stay in villas in Berawa, Pererenan or Batu Bolong. Days revolve around the villa pool, beach cafes with play areas and surf lessons for older kids.
What our nannies do here
Pool supervision at your villa, playdates at family cafes, nap routines while you surf or work from a coworking space, and evening babysitting for dinners out.
Good to know
Canggu beaches are black sand with strong waves and currents — children should swim only between flags or in the pool. Traffic is heavy at peak hours, so we book nannies who live nearby.

seminyak.name: Seminyak
seminyak.lead: Boutique villas, beach clubs and restaurants — Seminyak is Bali's stylish base for families who like to go out.
txt: Families in Seminyak
Private-pool villas and beachfront resorts sit close to some of Bali's best restaurants. Families split days between the villa, the beach and shopping streets.
What our nannies do here
Evening babysitting while you dine or visit a beach club, pool and play time at the villa, and help with bedtime routines.
Good to know
The surf is strong along Seminyak beach — supervision near the water is essential. Many beach clubs are adults-focused in the evening, so a sitter at the villa is the easy option.

kuta-legian.name: Kuta & Legian
kuta-legian.lead: Close to the airport and Waterbom, Kuta and Legian are an easy first stop for families arriving in Bali.
txt: Families in Kuta & Legian
Big hotels with kids' pools, shopping malls and Waterbom waterpark make this area practical, especially after a long flight.
What our nannies do here
Jet-lag nights with a night nanny, hotel pool afternoons, and a day at Waterbom with an extra pair of hands.
Good to know
Kuta beach has beginner surf schools but also rips — swim between the flags. Streets are busy, so we plan outings around short walks and taxis.

ubud.name: Ubud
ubud.lead: Rice terraces, jungle villas and cooler air — Ubud is Bali's cultural heart and a gentle place for kids.
txt: Families in Ubud
Jungle villas with pools, craft workshops, dance shows and rice-field walks. There's no beach, but the climate is milder than on the coast.
What our nannies do here
Villa days with pool and nature play, company on rice-field walks, and babysitting while you take a yoga class or a cooking class.
Good to know
Many villas have steep steps and unfenced pools — tell us about the layout so we can plan safety. Keep children away from monkeys at Monkey Forest and temples.

uluwatu.name: Uluwatu
uluwatu.lead: Clifftop resorts, famous sunsets and hidden beaches — Uluwatu is Bali at its most dramatic.
txt: Families in Uluwatu
Families usually stay in clifftop resorts or villas with big pools. Beaches like Padang Padang and Melasti are beautiful but reached by stairs or steep roads.
What our nannies do here
Pool supervision at your villa, beach time at calmer spots at low swell, and evening babysitting so you can watch the Kecak dance or a clifftop sunset.
Good to know
Many beaches are for experienced surfers — choose calm days and stay close. Monkeys at Uluwatu Temple grab belongings; small children are safer in a carrier there.

jimbaran.name: Jimbaran
jimbaran.lead: A wide, calm bay with seafood dinners on the sand — and just 15 minutes from the airport.
txt: Families in Jimbaran
The bay is gentler than Bali's west coast, and large resorts have kids' clubs and shallow pools. Sunset seafood dinners on the beach are a family tradition.
What our nannies do here
Beach mornings, resort pool time, and an evening sitter so parents can enjoy a quiet dinner.
Good to know
Waves are usually moderate but change with the season — check conditions before swimming. Jimbaran is a convenient base for short stays near the airport.

nusa-dua.name: Nusa Dua
nusa-dua.lead: Manicured resorts, calm reef-sheltered beaches and kids' clubs — Nusa Dua is Bali's classic family resort area.
txt: Families in Nusa Dua
A gated resort enclave with wide beaches, calm water and big hotels built for families. Everything is flat, clean and easy with a stroller.
What our nannies do here
Private care when the kids' club is full or your child is too young for it, pool and beach time, and evening babysitting in your room.
Good to know
Hotels have their own policies for external sitters — we coordinate with reception in advance. The Bali Collection area has shops and restaurants within walking distance.

denpasar.name: Denpasar
denpasar.lead: Bali's capital, where many expat and local families live close to international hospitals and schools.
txt: Families in Denpasar
Denpasar is less about holidays and more about everyday life: homes, schools, malls and the island's main hospitals.
What our nannies do here
Long-term and part-time nannies for resident families, after-school care and help at home.
Good to know
Traffic can be heavy, so we match families with nannies from the same part of town and agree on fixed hours.
